_comment_home_icons: Home-screen navigation icons are all the same blue rounded square differing only by glyph, so they cross-match each other. Measured against a real home screen: an icon that IS present scores 0.92-0.97, one that is ABSENT peaks at 0.38-0.61 (Home.Pet hits 0.614 over the Mail icon). Pinning 0.85 separates those cleanly, and a pinned threshold also suppresses the time-decay that otherwise slides down to a 0.6 floor and matches the wrong icon.
